android.desc:
Utter is a voice-to-text productivity app built for people who want to convert their voice into Notes, Tasks and Journals.

Most voice note apps only transcribe what you say and leave you to sort everything out yourself. Utter is different. It helps you turn your voice into organized Notes, To-Dos, and Journals in real time, so your ideas are easier to capture, easier to find, and easier to use.

Whether you are saving a quick idea, recording lectures, adding a todo, planning your day, recording a reflection, or capturing meeting notes, Utter helps you go from speech to structured content in seconds.

📝 THREE POWERFUL MODES

📋 Notes
Capture ideas, meeting notes, lecture points, reminders, brainstorming sessions, and random thoughts. Instead of losing ideas or typing them later, just speak and let Utter turn them into clean, readable notes.

✅ To-Dos
When you choose To-Do mode, what you say becomes an actual checkable task, not just another paragraph of text. This makes Utter useful for task management, daily planning, grocery lists, errands, follow-ups, and quick reminders.

📓 Journals
Use your voice to record reflections, gratitude entries, personal thoughts, daily logs, and stream-of-consciousness journaling. Speaking often feels faster and more natural than typing, especially when you want to capture thoughts in the moment.

WHY PEOPLE USE UTTER

Voice to text in real time
- Utter converts your speech into text as you speak, helping you capture thoughts before they disappear.

No login required
- Start using the app without creating an account.

No ads
- We don't have annoying ads and we don't sell your data.

Privacy-first approach
- Your notes, journals, and to-dos are stored locally on your device. You can delete it anytime.

Organized voice notes
- Utter helps separate your content into Notes, To-Dos, and Journals so everything stays structured.

Checkable voice to-do list
- Turn spoken tasks into actionable checklists you can manage and complete.

Fast note capture
- Save ideas, reminders, and important information without opening a keyboard.

Easy journaling
- Record your day, emotions, reflections, and personal insights hands-free.

Folders and search
- Keep everything organized with folders and quickly find what you need using search.

WHO UTTER IS FOR

Professionals
 Capture meeting notes, action items, ideas, and follow-ups while working.

Students
 Record lecture notes, revision ideas, study
